D019_l001.question:

Clinically significant avoidance is noted, particularly in efforts to suppress distressing memories, thoughts, and emotional responses associated with the trauma. The patient exhibits heightened auditory startle reflexes, manifesting as physical flinching in response to unexpected sounds. Concomitant irritability and impulsive anger outbursts have emerged, occurring disproportionately to environmental triggers or in the absence of clear provocation.  

These symptoms have resulted in marked functional impairment, affecting occupational performance and daily functioning. The onset of symptoms occurred within one month of the traumatic stressor and has persisted for two weeks. There is no indication of symptom onset prior to the event, and no other medical or psychiatric conditions are reported to account for the clinical presentation.
